name: What is the difference between an hourly painter and a full interior paint package?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an hourly painter and a full interior paint package?

acceptedAnswer.text: An hourly painter charges based on the time spent on the job, which can be unpredictable for larger projects and may not always include materials. A full interior paint package, like those offered by City Dweller, LLC, typically provides a comprehensive, fixed-price quote covering all labor, surface preparation, materials (paint, primer, supplies), and cleanup. This offers cost predictability and ensures a complete, high-quality finish without hidden fees, focusing on the entire project's scope rather than just labor hours.
acceptedAnswer.description: An hourly painter charges by time, while a full interior paint package is a fixed-price quote including all labor, materials, and cleanup for predictability.
